radiation.label: Deinococcus-type radiation and desiccation resistance
radiation.note: Deinococcus DNA-damage-response proteins. Absence does not rule out resistance: other radiation-resistant lineages use different strategies.

heat.label: Reverse gyrase (thermophily marker)
heat.note: Reverse gyrase is present in all known hyperthermophiles (optimal growth at or above about 80 C) and in some thermophiles such as Thermus; rare in mesophiles (Forterre 2002, Trends Genet).

salt.label: Ectoine osmoprotection (salt-out strategy)
salt.note: Ectoine synthesis genes. Salt-in halophiles such as Halobacterium lack these and instead have a strongly acidic proteome (see acidic_excess).
